mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sa_document_version WHERE document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
WHERE document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_document_version SET current_task_id=#{taskId},process_status='UPLOADED',publish_status='DRAFT',progress=0,chunk_count=0,error_message=NULL,content_hash=#{contentHash},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND current_task_id <=> #{expectedTaskId} AND process_status='FAILED'

UPDATE sa_document_version SET process_status=#{status},progress=#{progress},chunk_count=COALESCE(#{chunkCount},chunk_count),error_message=#{errorMessage},content_hash=COALESCE(#{contentHash},content_hash),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND current_task_id=#{taskId} AND process_status IN ('UPLOADED','PARSING','CHUNKING','EMBEDDING')
UPDATE sa_document_version SET publish_status='IN_REVIEW' WHERE id=#{id} AND process_status='READY' AND publish_status='DRAFT'

UPDATE sa_document_version SET publish_status=CASE WHEN #{decision}='APPROVE' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},review_comment=#{comment},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND publish_status='IN_REVIEW'
UPDATE sa_document_version SET publish_status='PUBLISHED',published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND process_status='READY' AND publish_status='APPROVED'
UPDATE sa_document_version SET publish_status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE id=#{id} AND publish_status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE sa_content_dependency SET review_status='NEEDS_REVIEW',detected_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE source_version_id=#{versionId} AND review_status IN ('CURRENT','CONFIRMED')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_document_version WHERE storage_key=#{storageKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_document_version SET process_status='FAILED',error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE process_status IN ('UPLOADED','PARSING','CHUNKING','EMBEDDING') AND update_time<TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-#{timeoutSeconds},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY update_time,id LIMIT #{batchSize}
